description: This PHP source file defines the `ShippingMethod` class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class handles checkout shipping methods by rendering shipping options, validating shipping selections, and saving selected shipping method data to the session during the checkout process.

classes.name: ShippingMethod
classes.description: Handles checkout shipping methods, providing functionalities to display available shipping options, validate user selections, and save shipping method data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the shipping method view, displaying the selected shipping method name and code to the checkout page.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Returns available shipping quotes based on the customer's cart and address, or an error message if validation fails.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the chosen shipping method to the session, ensuring all checkout conditions are met.
